title: Audio buffer position adjustment
summary: Recovered the cdecl callback at VA 0x58e330 as readable portable C++. Rewinds reject amounts past the current signed position. Advances reject INT_MIN, compare wrapped signed availability, restore the checkpoint on insufficient data, and commit the new position before testing its sign and the wrapped base-relative sum. Returns exactly zero or minus one. Only the position DWORD is written. Original callback pointer resides in table 0xbaf500 at slot +0x1c, installed at object offset 0x6d3c. Accepted oracle was verified against all 158 original bytes; no matching-source credit claimed.
test_description: GCC freestanding i386 harness directly compares 3341 cases with original_audio_buffer_adjust_position linked at VA 0x58e330: ten explicit result/position assertions, 1331 signed boundary combinations and 2000 deterministic pseudorandom states. Covers zero, exact rewind/advance, overrun rollback, INT_MIN rejection, negative initial positions, wrapped subtraction/addition and failure after position commit. Compares the entire 0x6d94-byte partial object and separately verifies every byte outside position remains unchanged. No imports or FS registration are used by this routine. Local accepted oracle byte check passed; local GCC behavioral execution passed. MSVC2013 compilation checked at O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Partial object layout only; field names describe observed roles, not recovered original identifiers or confirmed audio units.
The callback table installation is identified, but concrete indirect calls to this particular slot have not been uniquely resolved.
Tests use valid writable object storage; invalid pointers and concurrent modification are outside the recovered contract.
No full audio decoder, OS behavior or game integration is recovered, and compiler byte equivalence is not claimed.
